integrity: The proof is an exact consequence of the published general angle formula and maximal-angle/Hadamard characterization, followed by explicit Kronecker-product algebra. No numerical experiment is used as proof. The closest tensor-stability theorem was inspected and compared at statement level.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns complex finite-dimensional matrix masas and requires one tensor factor pair to have maximal interior angle. It does not give a scalar tensor formula for two arbitrary nonmaximal pairs and does not identify higher-dimensional Kadison--Kastler distances.
title: Exact Hadamard-factor tensor law for interior angles of matrix masas
